primary_proposed_substrate.name: SciAgentGym

scope_verdict.recorded_stance: count all 259 tasks citing the paper's aggregate licence-compliance claim and Appendix B.2 Table 6; document the per-task provenance gap as a limitation; do not author replacement tasks

intervention_fit.INFORMATION: withhold a benchmark-provided data file / DB row
intervention_fit.ACCESSIBILITY: unregister or rename a registered tool in usage_tool_protocol; alter parsing/access path with bytes preserved

top_risks: 49% of base tasks provenance-ambiguous (filename-only mapping; no source field); freeze can only cite the paper's aggregate compliance claim
executability untested and dependencies unpinned; stratified dry-run required before freezing executable counts
domain skew: Physics 49% of tasks; all Life Science gpqa_cellbio and all Astronomy tasks are GPQA-derived, so an exclusion wave hitting GPQA breaks domain breadth before the 120 count

named_fallback_substrate.weakness: hypothesis-matching (LLM-judged) success metric; mitigation would be a deterministic sub-check layer added in the A4 harness, documented as harness addition, never substrate modification

reasons: substrate shared with the frozen A2 campaign makes the two studies' error structures dependent

pin dependency versions for the run environment
replace the shipped third-party proxy config with the frozen model-lane configuration
freeze domain-stratified development/primary/replication partitions per the A4 prereg before any protected agent run
